detail: Stops new high-value homes in wildfire-exposed areas and non-renews some; CEO cites inadequate approved rates. Later reopened with stricter wildfire underwriting.
AIG exits the admitted California homeowners market.
Pauses new homeowners, condo and commercial policies; existing customers renewed.
USAA Casualty stops writing new California policies, citing rate inadequacy.
Stops accepting new homeowners applications (construction costs, catastrophe exposure, reinsurance). Still paused as of 2026.
Caps new homeowners policies at 7,000 a month.
Raises the monthly cap to 9,500 and reopens condo/renters lines.
Removes the cap on new homeowners policies, crediting the Sustainable Insurance Strategy.
Stops new policies in Dec 2023 and non-renews all California homeowners policies by June 15, 2025.
Non-renews ~30,000 homeowners/rental/HOA/business policies (plus ~42,000 commercial apartment policies from Aug 20, 2024).
Stops offering Farmers-branded home, auto and umbrella policies and non-renews them; Foremost and Bristol West unaffected.
Non-renews a small share of higher-exposure homeowners policies; keeps writing new ones.
Non-renews 10,525 personal lines policies (4.4% of its NC book) based on hurricane hazard, renewals Dec 2023 - Jul 2024.
